about_the_game:
☣️ High School 53: The Erebus Protocol

"Where the government contract ends, the slaughterhouse begins."

📄 Game Summary (Overview)

Highschool 53: The Erebus Protocol is a first-person, psychological, and technological survival horror game. It takes place in an abandoned government building in the heart of Saudi Arabia, where Lumina Corporation is working against a mysterious criminal organization called Erebus. You are not a woman, and you are not a superhero; you are simply a maintenance technician trapped in a biodiversity that is beyond your comprehension.

🧠 Story (Narration)

High School 53 had secured a massive contract with the Ministry of Education and the Neural Information System for schools, but High School 53 was hiding a dark secret: a secret Erebus headquarters dedicated to studying the manipulation of humans after construction.

After a suspicious "incident" that legally shuts down the school, Ahmed (a maintenance technician) is sent on a nighttime mission, to the very end, to the electronic level. Upon entering the vault, the self-isolation protocol is activated, and communication with Lumina is severed. Ahmed officially finds himself at Erebus headquarters with human specimens who know nothing of mercy.

Key Game Features:

Double-Facade Horror: The terrifying contrast between government classrooms and underground surgical labs.

Tablet System (Erebus OS): Your tablet is your lifeline. Use it to hack security cameras, decrypt organ exchange archives, and unlock doors.

Behavioral AI: Crime doesn't haunt you; it aids your healing. It communicates afterward, remembers your hiding places, and reacts to your fear levels.

Technician's Arsenal: No firearms. Defend yourself with maintenance tools; use a Samsung device to lock doors or stun guns to disable the finishing touches.

Hyper-Realism: No HUD. You navigate through your smartwatch, your tablet your map. Immerse yourself in a cinematic audio experience that lets you hear Ahmed's breathing and the monsters' footsteps on the entertainment channel.

🩸 Content (Mature Content Description)

The game includes intense Body Horror scenes, including:

Depiction of mutilated victims of genetic experiments.

Non-military operations.

Controversial psychological themes of treason and human trafficking.

🖥️ Technical Specifications

Engine: Unreal Engine 5 (with support for Lumen and Nanite technologies for stunning realism).

Platforms: PC (Steam), PS5, Xbox Series X/S.

Languages: Full Arabic language support (dubbing and menus), in addition to English and other international languages.

🛠️ Additional Site Information (Store Tags)

Genre: Survival Horror, Mystery, Dark Sci-Fi.

Mode: Single Player (One Player).

🕯️ Air Inhalation (The Hook)

"Lumina built the wall. Erebus built the slaughterhouse. And you just fixed the door."

"Lumina built the wall... Erebus built the slaughterhouse... and you just fixed the door."

short_description: Highschool 53 is a first-person psychological survival horror game. As a technician trapped in a decommissioned school, use maintenance tools to hack systems, weld doors, and evade feral genetic experiments. Uncover the dark truth of the Erebus Protocol before the facility consumes you.
